info.name: Triton Inference Server NVIDIA Triton Inference Server HTTP/REST CUDA Shared Memory Health API
Triton Inference Server Server Liveness Check

items.docs: Check if the Triton server is alive and able to receive requests. This is the KServe V2 standard liveness probe endpoint.

info.name: Triton Inference Server Server Readiness Check

items.docs: Check if the Triton server is ready to accept inference requests. The server is ready when all models that are loaded at startup are ready.

info.name: Triton Inference Server Model Version Readiness Check

items.docs: Check if a specific version of a model is ready to accept inference requests.

info.name: Triton Inference Server Model Readiness Check

items.docs: Check if a model is ready to accept inference requests. Checks the default/latest version of the model.
